units.text: Keep agent learning scoped and redacted; verify storage and model-processing boundaries. Learned rules cannot automatically gain global or normative authority: promotion needs evidence, counterexamples, generalizability and authorized review. Do not infer permission for transcript collection or background observers.

Before enabling changed agent plugins, hooks, skills or MCP, review effective source/dependencies, instructions, permissions, data flows and rollback. Preserve existing config and approval boundaries; registration or a score is not runtime proof. Leave unreviewed changes disabled.
Where interface breakage is harmful, verify implementation compatibility using schema, contract, generated-client, or consumer integration evidence; syntax alone is insufficient.
Verify the migration or data transformation path when the change alters durable state.
Treat migrations as executable changes to production state rather than ordinary source edits.
Exercise allowed and denied actor/resource combinations, including other-user, other-tenant, and admin-only paths where applicable.

Verify the approved conversion path with synthetic data: success/failure, retries/reloads, deduplication, accepted/denied/withdrawn consent, environment exclusions and payload privacy. Check actual authorized destination receipt/count, not just a fired tag. Link revision and observed evidence; mark inaccessible boundaries NOT RUN. A phone/WhatsApp click does not prove a lead.

Use pb-lead-qualification-and-handoff: qualify with dated business evidence and honest unknowns; preserve the existing CRM/stages, owner and next action. Public/valid contact details do not establish outbound permission: check the channel's LSSI/GDPR basis and suppression separately. Drafts pending permission are not approved to send. Keep private/sensitive data out of public artifacts; verify only authorized record changes.

Use pb-marketing-context-and-content: reuse the approved local brief, audience/job, available offer, voice, proof and next action; preserve point-edit scope. Separate observed competitor facts from inference and unavailable evidence. Diagnose intent/CTA/friction before CRO changes; do not invent proof or uplift. Keep private facts local and route design/SEO to their existing owners.

Prespecify the experiment hypothesis, population/allocation, outcome/denominator, guardrails, analysis, justified sample/effect/duration and stopping rule. Check data quality and uncertainty before a decision. Low traffic may require qualitative work or an inconclusive result; do not invent uplift or declare a winner from clicks, peeking or unsupported sample assumptions.

For a material hero change, verify desktop and 320px/390px/200% zoom, mobile crop, H1/CTA, exact owner-approved carousel controls (Agurto: five buttons, no pause/play), requested photo timing, independent word timer, reduced motion, background/menu lifecycle, WCAG 2.2.2 mechanism or documented gap, exact-SHA build and live browser smoke; report unrun gates.
Keep focused editable content and required actions reachable and visible when virtual keyboards, fixed navigation, sheets, or safe areas reduce the usable viewport.
Repeated mobile capture/search loops must keep focused input, result selection, Enter/IME behavior, and the next required action usable without requiring manual keyboard dismissal.

Use representative real-device verification when acceptance depends on installed-PWA, virtual-keyboard feel/layout, safe-area geometry, or camera ergonomics; otherwise record that physical gate as not run.
Keep routine mobile continuation steps within one overlay/surface; do not stack routine dialogs, sheets, or popovers without a distinct safety reason.
Do not log secrets, authorization tokens, or unnecessary sensitive payloads; treat telemetry volume, retention, PII, and cardinality as production concerns.
Do not treat a successful build or CI run as proof that the deployed product is healthy.
Verify environment-appropriate runtime identity, reachability or health, and material failure visibility for production-relevant changes.

Verify compact first desktop render, transient hover/focus expansion, explicit pin persistence, unpin plus pointer-exit retraction without latched focus, keyboard and aria-current, authorized navigation, and mobile drawer at 320px and 200% zoom. Check theme SSR/no-flash and persistence failure reconciliation, curtain support and reduced-motion fallback, route/back/forward/loading/error continuity without blank flashes, and absence of a decorative global footer. Record build/test results and exact-SHA authenticated smoke where available; report unrun mobile/zoom/CI gates honestly.

If an operator-console change explicitly adopts Glassmorphism, verify a translucent chrome/opaque data/elevated-context hierarchy; actual-composite contrast, semantic focus and state, mobile 320px/200%-zoom, touch/keyboard, opaque blur fallback, reduced motion, data-dense scroll performance and tenant/brand isolation. Report all unrun visual/device/accessibility/performance gates rather than declaring the prototype production-ready.
Capture a reproducible baseline and compare the same journey, environment, data size, device/network class, and metric before claiming a performance improvement or regression gate.

For applicable public discovery, verify the exact hosted HTML/Markdown Accept and HEAD matrix, Vary/cache, real Link destinations and private negative cases. Record exemptions and DNS-AID authoritative/service evidence separately. Use the launch playbook's reusable HTTP probe.

Keep the owner's approved hero type family coherent across public headings, copy, navigation, cards, footer and forms, even if historic CSS shorthands specify a serif. Group practical first-visit information under the dental/consumer guide, preserve localized deep links, and keep primary navigation short and action-oriented. Verify computed type families on inner pages and 200% zoom.

Before handoff of a public client site, inspect 1440/768/390/320px, header and menus, hero/body typography continuity, each hero/gallery/review interaction including passive hover vs captured handle drag, keyboard/touch/reduced motion, quote validation/contact links, media truth, legal/noindex or production SEO, build/tests, exact deployed SHA, host READY and live desktop/mobile smoke. Report PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN honestly.

Test hover-without-press keeps a comparator unchanged, handle-only mouse and real touch drag capture and persist, keyboard arrows/Home/End work, labels match the layers, and generated standalone portraits load with honest demo provenance; verify at 320px, zoom 200% and reduced motion.

Apply std-public-web-discoverability-baseline and pb-public-web-discoverability-launch. Preserve approved noindex/private/demo gates; robots is not access control. Verify routes, canonicals, visible truth and rendered evidence. On eligible public content, default to real Link relations and negotiated Markdown from one source. DNS-AID is conditional on a real public agent service and authorized DNS. Eligibility is not indexing or AI citation.

Inspect each gallery panel on desktop, 390px/320px, keyboard tab/arrow/Home/End, touch swipe, zoom and reduced motion; check captions are readable, mobile portrait images load, selected details match and no page overflow or clipped inactive titles remain.

Check visible fictional-labeling and no fake Google attribution/schema in demos, real source links/consent in production, each unique card on 320/390px, seamless track, manual pause and focus/touch/reduced motion, no-JS fallback and hidden-tab behavior.
Do not infer native launcher, installed-shell, virtual-keyboard, camera, or OS behavior from browser automation; verify representative devices when release-critical or record the gate as not run.
Verify the expected immutable source or build identity, target environment, deployment result, and applicable post-deploy health or smoke evidence as distinct states.
Do not run local or demo reset/seed behavior against Production as ordinary release setup.
Verify denied paths and cross-role, cross-tenant, or object-access cases that are relevant to the changed authorization boundary.
Verify the credential lifecycle and that privileged or raw credentials are not exposed through client code or ordinary logs.
Prefer full-length immutable commit SHAs for third-party GitHub Actions, especially when workflows have secrets, write permissions, or deployment authority.
Do not give untrusted pull-request or fork execution production secrets or privileged deployment credentials.
A green CI result proves only the configured jobs that actually ran for that commit or run.
Verify migration order and target, schema/data result, and relevant compatibility or recovery behavior for persistent-state releases.
Verify the exact source/build identity and target environment for a production release or deployment.
Do not intentionally place credentials in source control, analytics payloads, error messages, normal logs, or unredacted screenshots and evidence.
Describe capabilities only at the strength actually supported by the environment being discussed.
Treat CI results and test doubles only as evidence for the gates and external systems actually exercised.
Production must not silently substitute mock or local persistence merely to make a workflow appear successful.
Target applicable user-facing web content to WCAG 2.2 AA and preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, meaningful naming/order, reflow, and non-color-only semantics.
Visible collection filters must be real predicates across rows, pagination, counts, and exports; clear or reconcile retained selection when a new predicate excludes it.
Preserve required information and actions at narrow widths and do not hide real layout defects with global overflow clipping.

Is the user task best served by a graphic for spatial comparison/trend/range/distribution or by a table for exact lookup/audit/action, and are any secondary exact values reachable without tooltip-only meaning?
Render and inspect materially visual changes at risk-relevant states and viewports, and report browser, device, accessibility, or visual gates that were not run.
Do not claim a gate passed unless it was executed and its result observed for the relevant change.
Map each material risk or invariant to its failure mode, cheapest reliable evidence, required environment, and explicit acceptance status.
Do not use unit tests as evidence that a remote integration, deployment, or physical-device behavior works.
Record applicable checks as passed, failed, not run with a reason, or not applicable rather than assuming success.
Assert the intended semantic UI state before capturing visual evidence; filenames or action attempts are not proof that the state was reached.

Bind visual evidence to build, route, semantic state, viewport/project/theme and artifact identity. A no-regression claim needs a reviewed comparable baseline; without one, report the comparison as not established, separately from new-design acceptance.
Do not report browser automation as proof of native launcher, virtual-keyboard, physical-camera, installed-PWA, or assistive-technology behavior that was not actually tested.
